# Ease | Satisium

> Canonical: https://ease.satisium.com/app
> Repository: https://github.com/satisium/ease (MIT License)
> Ecosystem: https://satisium.com (The Satisium Umbrella)
> Precision Cubic-Bézier curve editor and analytical ODE spring physics instrument for design engineers. Export production curves to CSS, Tailwind v4, Motion, and GSAP.

## Quick Answers

### What is Ease?
Ease is an interactive kinetic sandbox and motion curve studio created by Satisium for frontend engineers and design technologists. It enables developers to author, calibrate, and duel cubic-bezier transitions and analytical spring physics on authentic UI habitats before exporting production-ready code.

### How does Ease calculate analytical spring physics?
Ease models mass, stiffness, and damping using exact closed-form analytical solutions to second-order ordinary differential equations ($m \cdot x''(t) + c \cdot x'(t) + k \cdot x(t) = 0$). Settle times, resting thresholds, and peak velocities are evaluated mathematically rather than through frame-by-frame numerical approximations.

### How does Ease export CSS linear() and Tailwind v4 curves?
Ease samples continuous spring waveforms into quantized CSS `linear(...)` keyframe sequences using Ramer-Douglas-Peucker simplification. The resulting curve executes on the browser compositor thread with zero runtime JavaScript overhead, ready for direct integration into CSS stylesheets or Tailwind CSS v4 `@theme` blocks.

## Interactive Component Habitats (21 Components + Primitives Lab)

- Overlays: Modal Dialog, Action Sheet, Drawer, Toast Notification, Tooltip Popover, Floating Context Menu.
- Controls: Toggle Switch, Segmented Control, Slider Thumb, Stepper Counter, Interactive Button, Radio Group.
- Disclosure: Accordion Pane, Dropdown Select, Collapsible Tree, Expandable Search Bar, Tab Switcher.
- Landing: Hero Title Sweep, Feature Card Hover, Staggered Grid, Notification Banner.
- Lab: 4-Track Primitives X-Ray (Position, Scale, Rotation, Opacity) with 120fps TrackConductor telemetry.

## Export Formats & Links

- Native CSS: Standard `cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2)` and compositor-accelerated `linear(...)` spring approximations.
- Tailwind CSS v4: Pre-configured `--ease-*` timing tokens ready for utility class styling in `@theme` blocks.
- Motion (Framer Motion): Type-safe transition configs with exact `type: "spring"`, `stiffness`, `damping`, and `mass`.
- GSAP CustomEase: High-precision SVG spline definitions paired with calibrated settling durations.
- Lossless Sharing: State preservation via compact `#hash` URL encoding for friction-free developer handoff.
